context: M29 o1. Corwin lobby table. Bernard lays out what the leads have gathered, item by item.

lines.speaker: char.bernard_ostrow
lines.text: Exhibit one: the ledger, or its copy. Lisle's voice on every page.

lines.speaker: char.bernard_ostrow
lines.text: Exhibit: Miss Kell's carbons. Fifteen years, in a laundry bag.

lines.speaker: char.bernard_ostrow
lines.text: Exhibit: Sergeant Kearney's Christmas list. Sixty-nine to seventy-one.

lines.speaker: char.bernard_ostrow
lines.text: Exhibit: the lieutenant's own locker. His insurance, now ours.

lines.speaker: char.bernard_ostrow
lines.text: Exhibit: Miss Moore's photographs. Brannock, Wurtz, the park dealer.

lines.speaker: char.bernard_ostrow
lines.text: And a picture of a newspaper editor's brother-in-law drinking with Lisle.

lines.speaker: char.bernard_ostrow
lines.text: Now the question isn't what you have, Mr. Arce. It's who you give it to.
